canonical_source: Google Drive Type 1 Romer Cognigrex / sheets 149-150
purpose: Machine-routing mirror of the InterSol component/assembly and penetration/service definition layer. Drive remains canonical.
assembly_families: Free Flow test and operational storage interfaces

penetration_rules.preferred: cast-in sleeve/frame/receiver where known; controlled post-installed penetration only after applicable structural/fire/waterproofing/service review
penetration_rules.rated_boundaries: use tested firestop or protective assembly matching actual penetrant and boundary; every alteration re-receipted
penetration_rules.wet_boundaries: membrane/flange/collar continuity is independent from decorative finish
penetration_rules.below_grade: puddle flange/waterstop/hydrostatic sealing strategy is site/geotech dependent
penetration_rules.utility_segregation: power, data, water and gas are segregated according hazard/electrical/EMC/plumbing requirements; co-location never implies shared cavity
penetration_rules.maintenance: valves, dampers, junctions, traps and critical fasteners remain inspectable and replaceable

fixed_owner_interfaces.H40: nominal 40 mm heavy insert family with three-phase/data and selected water/gas-capable service suites; diameter is not a load rating
fixed_owner_interfaces.L30: nominal 30 mm frequent lighter insert family with power/data and selected water; no routine gas
fixed_owner_interfaces.primary_roof_rule: concrete roof remains independently structural, weatherproof and drainable if all detachable/motorised R&D modules are removed

hard_boundaries: No numerical fastener, anchor, cable, pipe, duct, sealant, membrane or protection rating is inferred from architecture alone.
No blast, ballistic, fire, pressure or cleanliness rating is claimed without complete tested/professionally designed assembly evidence.
No concealed service may be made inaccessible where inspection, isolation or maintenance is required.
No experimental Solar Hull, living, adaptive or Free Flow layer replaces the accepted conventional life-safety/weatherproofing baseline until separately qualified.
No contaminated process or trade waste is connected to stormwater or sanitary systems without an approved pathway.
